collection.description: An elder wakes up grumpy for no reason, and a cheerful villager arrives with a flower, a joke and some fruit.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is in a bad mood. There's no particular reason. Nothing went wrong. (subject.He/She) just woke up feeling cross and has stayed that way. (friend), who is very cheerful, has noticed, and has brought (subject.him/her) a flower, a joke and a plate of fruit.

choices.label: Tell (friend) Kindly to Let It Be

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: "Thank you," says (subject). "I'm just grumpy today. I'd like to stay grumpy, if that's alright." (friend) blinks, then nods. "Alright." (friend.He/She) leaves the fruit and goes. (subject) eats the fruit, still grumpy. The next morning (subject.he/she) wakes up in a perfectly good mood, for no particular reason either.

(subject) eats the fruit, still grumpy. The next morning (subject.he/she) wakes up in a perfectly good mood, for no particular reason either.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) sighs. "Go on, then. Tell me the joke." (friend) tells it. It's a very bad joke about a fish. (subject) doesn't laugh. (subject.He/She) does, however, tell (friend) a much better joke about a fish. (friend) laughs so hard (friend.he/she) drops the fruit. (subject) is still grumpy, but now (subject.he/she) is grumpy with company, which is a little better.
